method: Static reads, SHA-256 checks and matched-stub/evidence review only. No OCP, provider or NumPy imports; no CAD construction, STEP operation or test execution.

findings.finding: Native role classification requires Plane for base/lip and Cylinder for neck, while the generated geometry comes from trimmed BSpline/OffsetCurve edges. Generic revolution or spline surface adaptors fall into a side-only bbox-radius classifier, which cannot identify base radii and can label necks as sides.
findings.action: Map native roles from Generated(source_edge) history and verify those faces are in the actual body face inventory. Classify imported faces with unique representation-independent metrics.

findings.finding: TopoDS.Face(shape) is used with exception handling as a runtime shape-kind predicate. The matched stub only guarantees a typed return; a downcast can fail to validate the underlying TopAbs shape type.

The runner hashes source_pins.json before and after the attempt but does not compare it with an externally fixed reviewed digest. Source files and pin records can be changed together before execution.
findings.action: Bind root-go to an independently recorded expected digest for the reviewed pin file or equivalent immutable authorization record.

findings.finding: Only the child process has a 55-second timeout. Preflight, post-run hashing, persistence and receipt work have no 60-second outer deadline.
findings.action: Enforce a deadline across the complete capture lifecycle or describe the 60-second value as an unenforced target.

findings.finding: The input_gate member is duplicated with an identical current value. Standard Python JSON loading silently retains one occurrence.

geometry_scope.offset_sign: Consistent with the pinned OCCT correction: +3 mm, V=+Y, T cross V gives inward (-zprime,+rprime) in RZ.
